Please note: Discount does not apply to Flipper products. Only one gift per order.

Our special gifts are determined by the price of your order before tax and shipping. There is only 1 gift per order. Here's what you can expect:

  • Orders from €100 to €1000: Get equipped with a sleek RF Field Detector.
  • Orders from €1000 to €2000: Elevate your toolkit with a Chameleon Ultra.
  • Orders above €2000: Take your skills to the next level with a complimentary Flipper Zero!

No Codes, No Hassle: We believe in keeping things simple. So, there's no need to fumble around for discount codes. The 10% discount is automatically applied at checkout. Easy, right? 🛍️

For the Geeks and Gurus: At LAB401, we understand the passion and dedication of pentesters, security professionals, and ethical hackers. Our products are carefully curated to meet the high standards and specific needs of this vibrant community. So, whether you're a seasoned pro or just starting out, our Black Friday deals are tailored just for you! 💻🔍

Why Choose LAB401? We pride ourselves on providing top-notch, professional-grade security tools. With a focus on innovation and quality, LAB401 is your trusted partner in cybersecurity. Enhance your toolkit with our range of products, backed by the best service in the industry. 🌐

Ready, Set, Shop! Don't let these deals slip away! Visit lab401.com now and level up your gear with the best prices and the best service. Remember, these offers are available only from November 24 to 27, 2023. Grab your gear and join the ranks of satisfied LAB401 customers! 🌟
